Subject: SOC2 re-attest: renewal evidence scope & retention ask

Hi Rachel,

As we prepare for our upcoming renewal we need to confirm a few things on the SOC 2 side. Two asks from our InfoSec team: 1) increase audit-log retention to 540 days for a subset of routes that process PII, and 2) a staged evidence handoff so we can validate exports before accepting the full dataset.

Can Redwood (a) provide a proposed timeline for a phased export/validation run, (b) confirm whether there are incremental fees for the 540d retention carveout, and (c) share a short checklist of artifacts we should expect in the evidence bundle?

We want to avoid a big-bang transfer — ideally a 2–4 week dry run on a representative slice, then a full handoff. Also flagging that procurement will need an amended SOW if there are charges.

Thanks,

Hi Anita — thanks for the clear asks. Proposal below; attaching an evidence checklist and export guide for your team.

Summary proposal (high level)
- Phased handoff: 3-stage approach: 1) 1-week smoke export (sample 7–10 days), 2) 3-week dry run (representative traffic slice; log + KV snapshots), 3) full export+handoff. Estimated calendar: start week of Mar 22 -> complete by Apr 19.
- Retention carveout: Yes, we can extend retention to 540d for specified routes. Two options: A) retention-only add-on (no additional dedicated capacity) — incremental storage + export fees; B) retention + dedicated log throughput (recommended if FinEx needs frequent scanning) — storage + monthly reserved capacity.
- Pricing ballpark: retention-only option ~ $3,750/month for the carveout (storage + export ops) for the subset you described; retention+dedicated capacity starts at $7,500/month (seat + throughput). I will get exact numbers from sales.
- Evidence bundle contents (attached checklist): system configs, access logs, export manifest, sample indexed logs, SOC 2 control mapping doc, redaction notes where applicable.
- Next steps: 1) confirm desired routes and sample window, 2) legal to prepare amendment if you accept pricing, 3) schedule the smoke export date.

I attached: evidence-checklist.xlsx, export_instructions.pdf. I'll loop in our pricing and delivery owners for a firm cost and a proposed amendment draft.

Best,
